description: Noise classifier borderline cases and boundary contracts (Wave 2).
notes: Extends C08 with: mixed-script inputs (Hebrew+digit, Latin+digit), Latin acronym, short Hebrew word (2 chars), empty string, ratio-check boundary (len>2 required), phrase threshold at exactly 50% noise tokens, multi-word Latin phrase. No Stanza required.
profiles_note: The noise_profiles key in c08_noise_classification.json documents conservative/balanced/aggressive conceptually. These profiles are NOT implemented as a filter API in entity_classifier.py — classify_text and classify_phrase are profile-agnostic. Profile-specific filtering would require a separate post-classification layer that does not currently exist in the codebase.

classify_text_cases.description: Latin acronym 'PDF' — pure Latin, not noise
classify_text_cases.notes: All-caps Latin word classified as WORD_LATIN — no length/ratio rule fires for 3 ASCII letters

classify_text_cases.description: 'Q1' — Latin letter + digit — mixed alpha-num, noise
classify_text_cases.notes: len=2, non_letter_ratio=0.5, ratio check requires len>2 so NOISE_RATIO_NON_LETTER_HIGH does NOT fire; NOISE_MIXED_GARBAGE fires from class mapping instead

classify_text_cases.description: 'א3' — Hebrew letter + digit — mixed alpha-num, noise
classify_text_cases.notes: len=2, ratio check does not fire at len=2; NOISE_MIXED_GARBAGE fires from MIXED_ALPHA_NUM class mapping

classify_text_cases.description: 'אב' — two Hebrew letters — WORD_HE, not noise at default profile
classify_text_cases.notes: 2-char Hebrew word is pure Hebrew (he_ratio=1.0). NOISE_TOO_SHORT does not apply to WORD_HE. Default classifier does NOT treat short Hebrew as noise — aggressive profile (not implemented) would.

classify_text_cases.description: 'a1234' — 1 letter + 4 digits — MIXED_ALPHA_NUM; ratio check fires (len>2, ratio=0.8)
classify_text_cases.notes: non_letter_ratio=digit_ratio=0.8 > 0.6 AND len=5 > 2 — NOISE_RATIO_NON_LETTER_HIGH overrides NOISE_MIXED_GARBAGE from class mapping

classify_text_cases.description: '12' — pure 2-digit number — NUMBER, noise; ratio check does NOT fire at len=2
classify_text_cases.notes: len=2 is NOT > 2, so NOISE_RATIO_NON_LETTER_HIGH does NOT fire. noise_reason stays NOISE_NUMERIC_ONLY. Contrast with '123' (C08_03): len=3 > 2 → ratio fires and overrides to NOISE_RATIO_NON_LETTER_HIGH.

classify_text_cases.description: Empty string — PUNCT, noise (normalize_text returns empty string)
classify_text_cases.notes: Empty string handled as special case before the decision tree

classify_phrase_cases.description: Phrase with exactly 50% noise tokens (2/4) — phrase IS noise (threshold is >=0.5 inclusive)
classify_phrase_cases.notes: Tokens: 'ילד' (WORD_HE, not noise) + '123' (NUMBER, noise) + 'גדול' (WORD_HE, not noise) + '©' (SYMBOL, noise). noise_count=2, total=4, ratio=0.5. threshold is >=0.5 so phrase IS noise. Confirms boundary is inclusive.

classify_phrase_cases.description: Phrase with 25% noise tokens (1/4) — phrase is NOT noise
classify_phrase_cases.notes: Tokens: 'ילד' (not noise) + '123' (noise) + 'גדול' (not noise) + 'ABC' (WORD_LATIN, not noise). noise_count=1, ratio=0.25 < 0.5 → not noise.

classify_phrase_cases.description: Pure multi-word Latin phrase — not noise
classify_phrase_cases.notes: 2 WORD_LATIN tokens, 0 noise tokens — phrase is not noise. Covers multi-word Latin which was absent from C08 phrase cases.
